head: Console
What it does
Users
Owner
Address
rows: VVIP activity tracker. Shows each day who to contact, who to leave alone, and how. Tabs: Dashboard, Daily (with the Assigned list), Changes, Campaigns, Performance, Settings
Sends Internal Mail without the Back Office. Recipient lists built by formula from the BO; content per brand; HTML upload; scheduled sends
Outbound Telegram broadcast through per-brand bots, no ad budget. GENERAL and VVIP bots kept separate; scheduling, bulk send, full audit log
Attendance, leave requests and approval, lateness, waivers and leave balance. Staff see My Workspace; ATL and above see the admin pages

x: The VVIP Console address can change. Confirm the current link with your ATL. Its walkthrough is the Agent Handbook v2.0 (effective 3 Sep 2026).
The HR Portal is owned by HR. VIP RTN references it but does not maintain it. The iMessage and Telegram consoles are VIP RTN tools.
Bot tokens, passwords and staff records inside these consoles are sensitive. Never copy them into the Handbook or share them.
